purpose: Test whether an already-learned distributional belief representation contributes state-aligned incremental decision information without granting distributional gradients ownership of the Shared Decision Core.

arms.production_baseline: Frozen production Direction/Requested-Risk outputs; no bridge.
arms.aligned_belief_bridge: Disposable zero-residual decision bridge consumes frozen production Shared representation plus detached, state-aligned distributional belief quantiles.
arms.shuffled_belief_control: Architecturally and parametrically identical bridge with byte-identical initialization; distributional belief is shuffled by whole independent-future dependence groups within each split, preserving marginal belief geometry while breaking state alignment.

decision_bridge_semantics.direction_output: Frozen production direction logits plus disposable residual logits.
decision_bridge_semantics.requested_risk_output: Frozen production requested-risk transformed to logit space, plus disposable residual, then sigmoid back to [0,1].
decision_bridge_semantics.initial_residual: Exactly zero; pre-training bridge behavior must equal production bootstrap behavior.
decision_bridge_semantics.teacher_direction_target_probs_role: Training evidence for bridge mechanics; not Truth authority and not a realized-future label.
decision_bridge_semantics.teacher_requested_risk_target_role: Training evidence for bridge mechanics; requested_risk remains distinct from confidence.

negative_control.purpose: Distinguish state-aligned distributional belief information from parameter-count/capacity effects.

pass_meaning: Mechanics/authority PASS only. PASS means the bridge and control execute with legal gradients, deterministic group-level negative control, finite losses and unchanged production authority. PASS does not require aligned belief to beat control and does not create a market-information verdict.
